name: Mira Stoneward
source_profile: ● Mira Stoneward (NG) is a young historian and keeper of the Kin's ancestral records. Unlike Helga, she remains deeply fascinated by the Lost Holds and has spent years assembling accounts of their disappearance. She believes the diaspora has forgotten too much of its history and regularly corresponds with prospectors and scholars investigating the old mountain kingdoms.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 77 (source excerpt; may be partial)
